text:
Ethan Park: Quick preflight for tonight's deploy (01:00 UTC). Draft RN + escrow rollback owner below. Need ops + compliance ack.

Noah Singh: looking. what's being pinned?

Ethan Park: pinning model rev-2026-04-10, fallback rev-2026-03-30. Also shipping a jitter fix for batching and a tiny change to embedding headers (adds `client_request_id`).

Nina Gomez: embedding header change is additive; SDKs fine. I'll notify SDK leads and include a snippet.

Noah Singh: rollback triggers proposal: auto-pause if error-rate > 2% OR embedding invalids > 3%. manual rollback if p99 latency +10% for 10m or any OOMs on dedicated lanes.

Ethan Park: agreed. Add immediate rollback if any cold-start GPU memory spikes lead to failed initializations.

Nina Gomez: DeployBot please stage 8% canary at 01:00 UTC, automatic pause at 01:20 UTC for checks.

DeployBot: scheduled canary -> 8% @01:00 UTC, pause @01:20 UTC. Canary link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1845554321 Reaction: :gear:

OncallBot: night roster notified: @oncall-night assigned.

Noah Singh: who executes rollback? Ethan or me?

Ethan Park: I'll be primary rollback executor. Command: `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-30 --note="canary-thresholds"`. Noah, you're secondary.

ComplianceBot: compliance check complete; include the two-line EU/non-EU note in RN.

Ethan Park: internal announcement copy for #all-hands (paste):

```
Heads-up: Deployment scheduled for 01:00 UTC (8% canary). Changes: model pin for stability, batching jitter fix, and an additive embedding header (client_request_id). Expected progression: 8% -> hold at 01:20 UTC -> expand if healthy. No UI changes. If you operate integrations, expect an extra request header for tracing.
```

Noah Singh: tiny nit: say "expand to full if healthy" rather than just "expand if healthy".

Ethan Park: updated.

Nina Gomez: running smoke harness pre-hold. Command: `./ci/smoke --canary=8`. If >2 failures, we hold and investigate.

DeployBot: canary snapshot will post after rollout. Standing by for `deploybot promote` at hold release or `deploybot rollback` if thresholds breached.

Ethan Park: final preflight checklist:
- compliance ok (done)
- canary scheduled (done)
- rollback owner named (Ethan) (done)
- SDK leads notified (done)
- internal RN copy ready (done)

Ethan Park: if no objections I'll post the RN to #all-hands T-2h and proceed with schedule.

Noah Singh: no objections. monitoring.

Nina Gomez: good to go.

DeployBot: standing by.
